sources.title: Quality orders
sources.scope: Actual page fetched; purchase-reference inspections and advanced review actions.
supported_claims: Inspection records connect source inventory, tests and quantities.
Quality review can include test results and nonconformance evidence.
sources.limitations: No order creation, laboratory testing, certificate issuance, inventory release or regulatory assertion is implemented.

sources.title: Quarantine orders
sources.scope: Actual page fetched; inventory effects and WMS limitation.
supported_claims: Quarantine orders have distinct states and physical inventory effects.
With WMS, quarantine-order processing applies only to return sales orders.
sources.limitations: This incoming-lot packet reviews exported hold evidence and does not emulate a universal inbound quarantine workflow.

sources.title: Inventory blocking
sources.scope: Actual page fetched; sampling versus blocking and overlapping inventory records.
supported_claims: Inspection sample quantity is not always blocked inventory quantity.
Overlapping blocking mechanisms can appear to exceed physical stock.
sources.limitations: Normalized physical hold snapshots are fictional file exports, not a reconstruction of tenant-specific inventory transactions.

sources.title: Quality and nonconformance management overview
sources.scope: Actual page fetched; quality evidence, nonconformance and correction handling.
supported_claims: Quality review relates sampling, numeric tests, supporting documents and nonconformances.
Corrections and retests are separate evidence-bearing activities.
sources.limitations: Thresholds, specimen counts, retest authorization policy and queue priorities are invented. No ISO/AQL/regulatory certification.

sources.title: Quality management item sampling
supported_claims: Quality associations can use fixed sampling quantities.
Sampling and blocking configuration vary by process.
sources.limitations: The supplied fixed specimen minimum is only a fictional completeness rule, not an acceptance-sampling algorithm.
